culture.0.title: Walking the palaces in hanbok
culture.0.summary:
A Seoul history remembered through dress and photographs.
Check how palace admission works and the terms for hanbok rental.
culture.0.lead: From the moment you choose your outfit, the palace becomes part of your own travel scene.
culture.0.s0b: Choose a hanbok in a color and shape you like, then walk slowly through the palace courtyards and corridors. Capture the lines of the fabric along with the palace colors and the day becomes a memory of its own.
culture.0.s1t: Pair it with a nearby stop
culture.0.s1b: Link Seochon or Insadong to your palace visit, before or after. Dividing time between walking the palace and resting in the alleys makes the day feel much easier.
culture.0.tip: Check hanbok rental terms and return times separately from palace opening hours and closure days.
culture.1.title: Korean craft, made by your own hands
culture.1.summary:
Take home a memory through mother-of-pearl inlay or folk painting.
Seoul Culture Lounge lists bookings for each class.
culture.1.lead: With shimmering najeon and soft colors, put a day in Seoul into something small you made yourself.
culture.1.s0b: Add a hands-on class such as mother-of-pearl inlay or minhwa folk painting to your trip. Choosing materials and finishing the shape is a cultural experience in itself.
culture.1.s1t: Finding the class that fits you
culture.1.s1b: Compare what you'll make, how long the class runs, and the language of instruction. Seoul Culture Lounge program listings show which classes run on your dates.
culture.1.tip: Check whether each program is running, along with booking, materials, and eligibility. The pieces in the images are visualizations of the experience, not real student work.
culture.2.title: Learning K-pop dance to music you love
culture.2.summary:
Add moving to the music to the pleasure of watching it.
Confirm class days and the languages offered first.
culture.2.lead: Take one line of a song you love and remember it by moving to it in Seoul.
culture.2.s0t: A class that works for first-timers
culture.2.s0b: Break the choreography into small moves, learn them, then put them together with the music. It adds taking part with your body to a trip spent watching performances.
culture.2.s1b: Cheering each other on while learning together turns the class into another scene of the trip. Pick a program that matches your level and the music you like.
culture.2.tip: Confirm that a class runs on your visit date, along with level, language, and booking terms, and wear clothes you can move in.
tastes.0.name: Gwangjang Market
tastes.0.title: Seoul, tasted in a market
tastes.0.summary:
Choose bindaetteok, gimbap, or an assorted jeon platter,
and watch the market cook it right in front of you.
tastes.0.caption: Gwangjang Market · A meal found in the alleys
tastes.0.lead: Remember Seoul's market through warm bindaetteok and gimbap, and the energy of the people around you.
tastes.0.s0b: Pick from the market's signature dishes — bindaetteok fried golden, gimbap, assorted jeon — and enjoy watching them cooked, along with the mood of each stall.
tastes.0.s1b: Wander the market slowly, then continue with a walk along Cheonggyecheon. Linking the food with the waterway gives a downtown day a moment to breathe.
tastes.0.tip: Check menus, prices, and ingredients stall by stall. At busy times, allow extra time for moving and eating.
tastes.1.name: Myeongdong
tastes.1.title: A meal between shopping stops
tastes.1.summary:
Try Myeongdong's kalguksu and dumplings,
then take in the shops and the street around them.
tastes.1.caption: Myeongdong · Shopping and street food
tastes.1.lead: A warm meal found while browsing shops and streets. Enjoy eating and shopping in a single neighborhood.
tastes.1.s0t: Choosing a meal in the alleys
tastes.1.s0b: Look for dishes featured in Myeongdong's official tourism guides, such as kalguksu and mandu. Street food is worth browsing too as you pick the meal that suits your taste.
tastes.1.s1b: After shopping, compare Myeongdong's streets by day and by evening. If Namsan is on your plan, add the route and rest time that fit your starting point.
tastes.1.tip: Check opening hours and wait times at the shops you plan to visit, along with any dietary needs. The generated images are not photographs of specific stores.
tastes.2.name: Dongdaemun
tastes.2.title: A shared pot in an alley of flavor
tastes.2.summary:
Eat in Dongdaemun's dakhanmari alley,
then explore the design and market culture around it.
tastes.2.caption: Dongdaemun · Dakhanmari, shared
tastes.2.lead: Share a bubbling pot and let the flavors of the alley carry the story of your trip.
tastes.2.s0b: Dakhanmari — chicken and vegetables simmered in a clear broth — is the signature experience of Dongdaemun's food alleys. For sauces and side dishes, follow each restaurant's guidance.
tastes.2.s1b: Link the markets and design spaces around Dongdaemun before or after your meal. You'll meet a traditional commercial district and a modern cityscape in one place.
tastes.2.tip: Check portion size, what the order includes, and ingredients. Markets, exhibitions, and shops keep different hours.
tastes.3.name: Seongsu
tastes.3.title: A cup of coffee and a neighborhood walk
tastes.3.summary:
Rest a while in a Seongsu café,
then wander the small shops and Seoul Forest.
tastes.3.caption: Seongsu · Time spent in a café
tastes.3.lead: A neighborhood where the texture of old spaces meets new taste. Leave room for one cup of coffee.
tastes.3.s0t: Taking a break in a café
tastes.3.s0b: Explore Seongsu's many cafés, including spaces that keep the feel of brick walls, large windows, and workshops. Choosing coffee and dessert is part of enjoying the place.
tastes.3.s1b: After the cafés and small shops, add a walk in Seoul Forest. Build some unhurried time into the route from alley to park.
tastes.3.tip: Check shop and pop-up hours for your visit date. The images are generated scenes evoking Seongsu's atmosphere, not specific cafés.
night.0.name: Hangang Park
night.0.title: Room to spare by the river
night.0.summary: Choose a walk or an outdoor activity to suit the weather and the season.
night.0.caption: Hangang Park · A walk at sunset
night.0.lead: Step away from the rush of sightseeing for a while, and give some time to the river breeze and the sunset.
night.0.s0t: The riverside at your own pace
night.0.s0b: Walk slowly along the river or rest on the grass and watch the view. The sky and the water change color around sunset and become the backdrop for the end of your day.
night.0.s1b: Pick a Hangang park that's easy to reach from your hotel or earlier plans. A Seongsu and Seoul Forest day can connect to the Ttukseom section.
night.0.tip: Check the weather and each park's visitor information, and decide your route home and timing after being outdoors.
night.1.name: N Seoul Tower
night.1.title: The city lights in one view
night.1.summary: Check observation deck hours and bookings, and how you'll get back.
night.1.caption: N Seoul Tower · The city from the hilltop
night.1.lead: A tower rising above the trees and a city opening wide below. Take in the scale and rhythm of Seoul.
night.1.s0t: Time set aside for the view
night.1.s0b: Watch the city shift from daytime colors into evening lights. You can combine a walk on Namsan with a visit to the observatory to suit your taste.
night.1.s1b: Consider eating and shopping in Myeongdong, then heading up to Namsan. Build the ascent, the queue, and the viewing time into your schedule.
night.1.tip: Check observatory hours and booking terms, and how to reach Namsan. Visibility varies with the weather.
night.2.name: Seoul Dal, Yeouido
night.2.title: Seoul from the sky
night.2.summary: Seoul Dal's operation depends on the weather. Check the day's information.
night.2.caption: Seoul Dal, Yeouido · Rising above the park
night.2.lead: From a tethered helium balloon rising straight up over Yeouido Park, meet the Han River and the city at a different height.
night.2.s0t: What kind of ride is it?
night.2.s0b: Seoul Dal is a helium balloon tethered to the ground by cables. It rises over Yeouido Park for a viewing experience that looks down on the city and the Han River.
night.2.s1t: From the ground to the sky
night.2.s1b: Add the Seoul Dal ride to a walk in Yeouido Park. Allow easy time for boarding and waiting, and picture the city at dusk.
night.2.tip: Rides are suspended in high winds or heavy rain. Check official operating information and boarding conditions before you set out.
